in_sample_statement: Stage-A is in-sample and selects nothing shippable: weights maximize cycle-window overlap on the same full-history series they are measured on; only the Stage-B walk-forward gate judges.

entry_point.mirrored_call: optimize_stage_a_weights(dates, valuation_z=<frozen generic_valuation/log_quadratic full-history rails, seed-identical>, extra_z=<15 gold extras>, windows=SdcaCycleWindows.gold_v1(), search_names=search_names_with_data(stage_a_search_names(profile), extra_z), grid=(0.0,0.5,1.0), valuation_grid=(0.0,0.5,1.0))
entry_point.not_used: fit_sdca_weights_from_cache / MCP run_fit_sdca_weights: sources_from_optional_paths() stages only m2/dxy/eth, so gold macros cannot flow through; no engine change made (STOP respected).

objective.parsimony_rule: exact-objective ties -> fewer enabled extras, then higher valuation weight

skipped_no_data: rs_eth (no ETH sibling staged; also meaningless for gold)
data.hy_ig_note: hy_oas/ig_oas have data (732d from 2023-10-27) but zero trough-window overlap (latest trough window ends 2022-12-05), so every combo enabling them raises in cycle_overlap_score and is skipped by the shipped try/except (stage_a.py:170-172); verified on 1082 sampled combos (shipped-raise 1082, vectorized-skip 1082).

acceleration.method: chunked float64 matmul over window days only; identical grid, identical null rule (composite_risk.py:6-7), identical formula, identical tie-break incl. shipped loop order (valuation outer).
